coal.name: coal
coal.desc: A black lump that burns long and hot.

crystal.name: crystal
crystal.desc: A clear crystal that holds a faint light of its own.

torch.name: torch
torch.desc: A stick wrapped in plant fiber and charcoal. Light it at a burning campfire (light).

lit_torch.name: lit torch
lit_torch.desc: A burning torch. It lights the dark around you, and burns down to a stick.

crystal_lamp.name: crystal lamp
crystal_lamp.desc: A crystal set in a holder; it glows without burning out.
